comments.author: sulaiman
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking: using the 1-minute preparation time
comments.text:
Dear Simon,

I am not an ielts teacher but I took the ielts test 3 times. My score was 7, 7.5, 7 in speaking. I used the following strategy: 1-draw a circle, then look at the questions. 2-put the topic in the centre of the circle. 3- the questions are all the times, where, when why ... 4-put theses questions on the circle 5- while you write them, try to remember something from your knowledge .

next stage, while you are speaking you have to look or pretend to look at your notes while you are speaking.

egards

sulaiman
